why: No major reviewer answers this; the authorities present are Home Assistant's own docs, which only describe VM requirements and hypervisors and never name a NAS. What answers the question are niche pages: three single-model UGREEN walkthroughs (one in video form), one maker-statement audit of 27 models with no testing, and a Canada-specific ranking. None ranks NAS models on verified Zigbee USB passthrough with current prices. A focused comparison page with a direct pick would stand out against these.
